item.title: Weather Impacting Palm Springs Police Phone Lines
item.description: The Palm Springs Police Department says weather conditions are impacting its phone lines.As a result, 911 calls are being temporarily rerouted to the Cathedral City Police Department to ensure emergency calls are answered without interruption.Non-emergency lines remain operational, but callers may experience delays or missed calls due to ongoing connectivity issues. item.description: A growing controversy is unfolding in downtown Palm Springs, where the city plans to reduce the size of a popular parking lot on North Palm Canyon Drive to make room for a new fire station.Flyers now line storefronts along the corridor urging residents to sign a petition to save the lot, which serves roughly 35 businesses. item.title: Florida man accused of smashing wrong SUV with hammer in grocery store parking lot
item.description: A Florida man is facing multiple criminal charges after deputies say he broke into and damaged an SUV with a hammer in a grocery store parking lot — mistakenly believing the vehicle belonged to his ex.The incident happened Friday at a Publix parking lot in Ormond-by-the-Sea, according to the Volusia Sheriff’s Office. item.title: Ash Wednesday Marks Beginning of Lent Across the Valley
item.description: Today marks Ash Wednesday, the beginning of the Christian season of Lent. Churches across the Coachella Valley, including Sacred Heart, are holding services and offering the traditional imposition of ashes. item.description: New developments in the case of 17-year-old T'Neya Tovar, the Hemet teen who was reported missing on December 1, as the man accused in her death appeared in court today.According to court officials, 51-year-old Abraham Feinbloom was arraigned Wednesday at the Imperial County Superior Court. item.title: U.S. Men's Hockey Beats Sweden in Overtime
item.description: Team USA is headed to the semifinals after scoring at the three and a half minute mark of overtime.
